_measured_from: the boot and dtbo partitions of the 5.4 image this phone runs (uname -r 5.4.302-vayu-kyler084-0.0.20), read back with dd over adb root
_why: ABL refuses an image with no AVB footer on this device: `fastboot boot` answers 'Failed to load/authenticate boot image: Load Error' and never enters the kernel. The device's own vbmeta uses algorithm NONE, so the footer carries only a salted SHA-256 of the image - no key is involved, which is why a mainline image can carry a valid one.
